description: SIP credentials of an Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connector, which your SIP hosts use to make outbound calls. Set them with PutVoiceConnectorTerminationCredentials. The Voice Connector must have termination settings, such as an AWS::Chime::VoiceConnectorTermination, before the deploy. Others can add credentials to the same Voice Connector, so Radius reads, changes, and deletes only the usernames in Credentials. AWS never returns a password, so Radius can't see a password changed outside Radius.

Id.description: VoiceConnectorId and a name Radius generates, joined with "|". The resource is the credentials in Credentials, so other credentials of the Voice Connector stay as they are.

VoiceConnectorId.description: The ID of the Voice Connector, such as the VoiceConnectorId of an AWS::Chime::VoiceConnector.

Credentials.description: The credentials, each a username and its password. A Voice Connector has at most 10, counting those others added.

Username.description: The RFC 2617 user name, in US-ASCII. Names that differ only by case are different credentials.
